frontmatter.sidebar_description: Set the rules of tax rates.

blocks.html: This documentation provides a reference to the `setTaxRateRulesWorkflow`. It belongs to the `@medusajs/medusa/core-flows` package.

This workflow sets the rules of tax rates.

You can use this workflow within your own customizations or custom workflows, allowing you
to set the rules of tax rates in your custom flows.

children.name: SetTaxRatesRulesWorkflowInput
children.description: The data to set the rules for tax rates.

children.name: id
children.description: The ID of the tax rate rule.

children.name: reference
children.description:
The snake-case name of the data model that the tax rule references.
For example, `product`.

Learn more in [this guide](https://docs.medusajs.com/resources/commerce-modules/tax/tax-rates-and-rules#override-tax-rates-with-rules).

children.name: reference_id
children.description:
The ID of the record of the data model that the tax rule references.
For example, `prod_123`.

Learn more in [this guide](https://docs.medusajs.com/resources/commerce-modules/tax/tax-rates-and-rules#override-tax-rates-with-rules).

children.name: tax_rate_id
children.description: The associated tax rate's ID.

children.name: tax_rate
children.description: The associated tax rate.

children.name: id
children.description: The ID of the tax rate.

children.name: rate
children.description: The rate to charge.

children.name: code
children.description: The code the tax rate is identified by.

children.name: name
children.description: The name of the Tax Rate.

children.name: metadata
children.description: Holds custom data in key-value pairs.

children.name: tax_region_id
children.description: The ID of the associated tax region.

children.name: is_combinable
children.description:
Whether the tax rate should be combined with parent rates.

Learn more [here](https://docs.medusajs.com/resources/commerce-modules/tax/tax-rates-and-rules#combinable-tax-rates).

children.name: is_default
children.description: Whether the tax rate is the default rate for the region.

children.name: created_at
children.description: The creation date of the tax rate.

children.name: updated_at
children.description: The update date of the tax rate.

children.name: deleted_at
children.description: The deletion date of the tax rate.

children.name: created_by
children.description: Who created the tax rate. For example, the ID of the user that created the tax rate.
